name: beta_neutral_stat_arb_v1
author: claude-4.6-opus-fast
thesis: High-beta NIFTY stocks (e.g., TATAMOTORS beta ~1.4) and low-beta stocks (e.g., HINDUNILVR beta ~0.6) exhibit intraday relative value dislocations when market-wide moves cause beta-proportional price changes, but idiosyncratic order flow creates residual mispricing. By constructing a beta-neutral portfolio (long high-beta stock with reduced size, short low-beta stock with increased size), we isolate and trade the alpha component. The inefficiency exists because most retail traders trade directionally and don't beta-adjust; institutional pairs desks focus on same-sector pairs. Cross-sector, beta-neutral trades are an under-exploited niche.
stock_filter: both stocks must have 30-day avg volume > ₹200cr/day and market cap > ₹2L cr

entry.entry_price: market orders, TATAMOTORS position = capital / (1 + hedge_ratio), HINDUNILVR = capital * hedge_ratio / (1 + hedge_ratio)

exit.stop_loss: alpha_z exceeds 3.0 OR loss > 0.5% of capital
exit.trailing_stop: once alpha_z within 0.5 of zero, trail at 1.0 sigma
exit.signal_exit: if beta_stability spikes > 0.5 during trade, exit (beta regime shift)

risk.position_sizing: beta-weighted: size_A = notional / (1 + beta_A/beta_B), size_B = notional - size_A

filters.vix_filter: India_VIX < 22; high VIX causes beta instability
filters.trend_filter: NIFTY not trending > 1.5% intraday (beta-neutral fails in strong trends)
filters.event_filter: skip if either stock has earnings, AGM, or corporate action within 3 days
other_filters: skip if NIFTY gaps > 1% at open (beta estimates unreliable post-gap)

edge.edge_decay_risk: low — cross-sector beta-neutral trades are niche and unlikely to be crowded

weaknesses: Intraday beta estimates from 120 1-min bars are noisy; the true beta can shift with market regime, causing the 'market-neutral' portfolio to have residual directional exposure
TATAMOTORS and HINDUNILVR are in completely different sectors (auto vs FMCG); the alpha spread may not mean-revert if divergence is driven by genuine sector-specific news
High-beta stocks like TATAMOTORS have wider intraday price swings, meaning the stop loss gets hit more frequently, reducing realized win rate vs theoretical
prior_art: Fama-French beta-neutral long-short (1993); Jegadeesh & Titman (1993) momentum residuals. Adapted for intraday Indian context with rolling beta adjustment.
notes: Edge math: 0.57 * 48bps - 0.43 * 35bps = 27.36 - 15.05 = 12.31bps gross. Costs ~12bps RT. Net ~0.3bps/trade is extremely thin. Edge of 22bps relies on 2-3 trades/day and occasional large alpha dislocations. May need to rotate stock pairs monthly for freshness.
